mainEntity.name: What materials are commonly used for deck replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common materials for deck replacement include pressure-treated lumber, cedar, redwood, and composite decking. Pressure-treated lumber is an economical and durable choice, while cedar and redwood offer natural beauty and resistance to insects and rot. Composite decking, made from recycled plastics and wood fibers, is a low-maintenance option that comes in various colors and styles. When selecting materials, consider your budget, desired aesthetics, and the level of maintenance you are willing to perform. Hometelligent Inc. can provide samples and discuss the pros and cons of each material during your consultation.
